lead: Low-level OS-thread primitives: `sys.Thread.spawn(...)`, `ThreadOptions`, `ThreadLocal<T>`, `OsMutex`, `OsRwLock`, `OsCondvar`, `OsBarrier`, `OsOnce`, process/dylib/pipe handles, CPU/thread helpers, signal hooks, and blocking sleep/yield operations. `sys.Thread.spawn` is compiler-defined; it returns the prelude `Thread<T>` handle with `join`, `detach`, and `done`.
